Set in pre-colonial [coastal Karnataka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanara "Kanara") , the prequel blends regional folklore and divinity into a narrative that explores man's relationship with nature. Filming began in November 2023. [B. Ajaneesh Loknath](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B._Ajaneesh_Loknath "B. Ajaneesh Loknath") composed the soundtrack and background score. The film was released on 2 October 2025, coinciding with [Dasara](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vijayadashami "Vijayadashami") .

Like the predecessor, _Chapter 1_ received positive reviews from critics. It became a commercial success at the box office and is currently the [second highest-grossing Kannada film of all-time](https://en.wikipedia.
